note: Featured Reads list for the upshurunlimitedllc.com homepage. Edit this file to change the shelf: array order is display order. Each entry's "u" is a book-page path that must exist in /assets/search-index.js (unknown paths are skipped). "price" is an optional verbatim price line for that card; omit it for free titles — free framing comes from the catalog record. If this file is missing or unusable, the homepage falls back to its built-in copy of the same list.
